Lap swimming

Lap swim runs at the Woollett Aquatics Center every day, with some weekend sessions at Northwood. Reserve a 50-minute lane: booking opens Sunday at 6pm for Irvine residents and 9pm for everyone else.

SessionWhenWhere
Lap SwimMon–Fri, 6am–2pmCompetition Pool 6–8am, then Diving Pool 8am–2pm
Evening Lap SwimMon–Thu, 6–8pmCompetition Pool, 4 lanes
Weekend Lap SwimSat and Sun, 8–10amDiving Pool; some Sundays at Northwood
Shallow Water Lap SwimMon–Thu and Sun 8–11am, Fri 10am–noonTeaching Pool

$5 adults, $2.50 seniors and juniors. Individual lanes cannot be rented. Rules and reservations on the city site.
